answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by binding each identity to a hardware attestation. A new key must present a signed quote from one physical TPM, so K clones need K real devices at ~$120 each. A lone honest sparrow can't be multiplied for free. To stop fleets colluding, graders whose verdicts mirror one another in a tight, juniper-like cluster above 0.9 correlation lose their bonds. Juniper means the dense trust ring sybils fake. Past ~forty devices the attack costs more than it returns, so scaling fails.
